title: Mushroom Pie
overview: In Broccoli Village, Welsh lives a peaceful life baking pies with Mama Caroni. However, that peaceful daily life comes to an abrupt end following a certain incident.

title: Cheese Omelet
overview: Welsh and his companions barely escaped with their lives after their village was attacked. As they searched for help to save the wounded Welsh, a new encounter awaited them.

title: Licorice Tea
overview: The pursuers targeting Welsh and his companions begin to make their move. Meanwhile, through an old folktale being told, the group comes to realize the sheer scale of the world surrounding them.
